name: gap-reader
description: Gap Reader: the Organizational Gap Reader and the Personal Gap Reader, from Breaking Point Leadership.

scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/org/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/personal/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: prisma db push --skip-generate --schema prisma/org/schema.prisma && prisma db push --skip-generate --schema prisma/personal/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/org/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/personal/schema.prisma
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema prisma/org/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/personal/schema.prisma
